prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet Experience", "Select the path that best matches how you want to interact with your new companion."]
1: ["Give Your Pet a Personality", "Choose whether your pet companion is playful, calm, or energetic."]
2: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop", "Access your pet anytime from the system tray icon to hide, summon, or chat.", "Right-click your desktop pet anytime for quick settings."]
3: ["Sign in to keep your pet safely backed up across sessions and avoid accidental profile resets."]
4: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Confirm your companion's details before placing them on your desktop."]
5: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Environment", "Rendering your pet and setting up desktop overlay tools. Please hold tight."]
6: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Create an interactive pet that lives right on your desktop in less than two minutes."]
7: ["Desktop Quick Start Guide", "Review key controls to manage your pet on your desktop seamlessly."]
8: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pet Profile", "Connecting your account ensures your companion data and custom assets remain linked to your system."]
9: ["We will send a desktop alert as soon as your pet companion is ready."]
